text:
Ava: Heads-up — prepping release notes + internal announce for the Wed change window (Wed 14:00 UTC). Need owners for notes, deploy checklist, canary cadence, and pin table. Draft below, please claim.

Ava: Draft notes snippet ->
```
Quick release summary:
- Runtime: small tokenization fix + rate-limiter adjustment to reduce tail latency spikes
- Canary: ramp 0.5% -> 5% -> 20% over 90m with health checks at each step
- Rollback rule: auto-pin to last-stable and traffic drain if 4xx+5xx > 4% for 3m
- Model pin matrix: rwinf-opt:2.0.0 (primary), rwinf-opt:1.9.7 (fallback)
```

Liam: I'll take the deploy checklist and add the preflight validation commands. Will verify the tokenization patch notes.

Nina: I'll own canary cadence and the deploybot schedule. Adding a warmup job for fallback model across ap-south and us-east. cc @deploy-bot for warmup slot.

deploy-bot: note: warmup slot available 2025-06-04T13:20Z. Suggested command: `deploybot warmup --model rwinf-opt:1.9.7 --regions us-east,ap-south --duration 25m`. Canary job template: `deploybot canary start --steps 0.5,5,20 --pause 30m --health-checks default`.

Sanjay: I'll write the rollback playbook steps and put exact CLI snippets in the runbook. Adding:
```
# immediate rollback pin
rwctl model pin set rwinf-opt:1.9.7 --all-regions && rwctl traffic set 0% --model rwinf-opt:2.0.0
```

Ava: Nice. For internal announce copy keep it punchy: 3 bullets max + link to runbook. DocsBot can you generate a short release-notes permalink after we finalize?

DocsBot: created draft page: https://internal.redwood/docs/releases/2025-06-04-draft (editable). Will generate final permalink on publish.

Liam: small question — do we need to note client SDK version compatibility? Tokenization fix touches token boundary behavior; might be relevant for customers using streaming SDK v0.9. If so, add a single line.

Ava: Good catch. Add a note: "SDK: streaming clients may observe minor token boundary changes; not expected to break applications." Keep it non-alarming.

Nina: Adding warmup + smoke check step: `deploybot smoke --model rwinf-opt:1.9.7 --sample 50` 15m before canary. Will include in canary plan.

Sanjay: Adding alert thresholds to runbook:
- SLO: p95 latency increase > 40%
- Error: 4xx+5xx > 4% sustained for 3m
- Cost: token cost spike > 2x baseline for 10m -> manual check

Ava: Owners recap: notes (Ava), deploy checklist (Liam), canary schedule + warmup (Nina), rollback runbook (Sanjay), docs permalink (DocsBot). Ops preflight: Tue 14:00 UTC 24h pre-alert from deploy-bot.

Liam: :thumbsup: I'll post the checklist snippet to the runbook and include exact `rwctl` verify commands by EOD.

Nina: :thumbsup: scheduled warmup reservation with deploy-bot, will paste confirmation.

deploy-bot: reserved warmup: 2025-06-04T13:20Z -> ticket #WB-8812. Will post 24h preflight message to #eng-releases on 2025-06-03T14:00Z.

Sanjay: :thumbsup: runbook updated, link -> https://internal.redwood/docs/release/runbooks/2025-06-04-playbook

Ava: Draft internal announce (please review):
- What: Minor runtime fixes (tokenization + rate limiting).
- When: Wed 14:00 UTC (canary); full rollout conditional on canary health.
- Expected impact: negligible user changes; streaming SDK may see token boundary tweaks.
Link: https://internal.redwood/docs/releases/2025-06-04-draft
Please review — we send preflight Tue 14:00 UTC.

Liam: approved from infra.

Nina: approved from runtime ops. Added warmup confirmation in runbook.

Sanjay: approved from oncall POV.

Ava: Thanks team. Ops follow-up: once deploy-bot posts the 24h preflight, we'll pin this thread and Ops will check go/no-go at Wed 13:40 UTC. If anyone updates runbook or notes, reply here with :eyes:.

DocsBot: final note: when you publish the release notes, include short changelog and anchor to runbook for oncall steps. I can auto-fill changelog from this thread if you respond `DocsBot: publish` in thread.

Ava: DocsBot: publish

DocsBot: Publishing draft -> final permalink https://internal.redwood/docs/releases/2025-06-04 (published).

Ava: Great. Closing loop — thanks all. If anything changes, update this thread or ping me directly.
